comparison.objective: Configure a meter test switch in a safe sequence and insert a test plug; candidate configures and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered blade-switch actuation and plug insertion versus hex-key engagement, collar rotation, counterholding and dynamic trial adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct safe switch order, seated plug and retention check versus isolated adjustment, two safe cycles and witness-tested collar retention.
comparison.reason: This is the closest procedural-control analogue, but it tests electrical-safe sequencing and plug retention rather than tuning from impact response. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift and witness-torque thresholds.
